day5_afternoon_start.name: Me
day5_afternoon_start.text: *Before I knew it, afternoon arrived. The sky seen from the rooftop is beginning to turn orange.*

day5_true_love_start.name: Me
day5_true_love_start.text: *Standing side by side under the sunset. I wish this moment could last forever.*

day5_true_talk_1.name: Me
day5_true_talk_1.text: "You know... Before I transferred here, I was scared of the new school."

day5_true_talk_2.name: Me
day5_true_talk_2.text: "But now... I think transferring here was the best decision of my life."

day5_true_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_true_seoyeon.text: "Me too... I'm so glad you transferred here. Let's stay together... always."

day5_true_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_true_yuna.text: "...I thought being alone was easier. But since you came... everything changed. Thank you."

day5_true_dain.name: Dain
day5_true_dain.text: "Every day became more fun since you came!! You'll keep cheering me on... right?!"

day5_true_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_true_nurse.text: "Our relationship won't be easy... But if it's with you, it's okay. Together, we can overcome anything."

day5_true_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_true_teacher.text: "...Honestly, a teacher shouldn't feel this way about a student. But what can I do, it's real. ...Let's make this work, us."

day5_true_kiss_buildup.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_buildup.text: *The wind blows. Their face, bathed in the sunset glow, feels unusually close.*

day5_true_kiss_2.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_2.text: *We look into each other's eyes. No words are needed.*

day5_true_kiss_5.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_5.text: *A soft warmth. Time seemed to stop.*

day5_true_kiss_after.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_after.text: *When I opened my eyes, they were smiling in the sunset light. The most beautiful smile in the world.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_1.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_1.text: *The sun has set. I was going to walk her home... but Seoyeon grabbed my sleeve.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_2.text: "...Um, my parents aren't home today. Just for a bit... do you want to come in?"

day5_bed_seoyeon_3.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_3.text: *A quiet residential street. Seoyeon opened the front door. Past the spacious living room, up to her room on the second floor.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_4.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_4.text: *A neatly organized room. A bookshelf full of books, student council papers on the desk. Soft ambient lighting. The room was filled with Seoyeon's scent.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_4b.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_4b.text: "...My parents' room is on the first floor, so it's fine. Oh, no that's not what I meant... Just, come sit here."

day5_bed_seoyeon_5.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_5.text: *We sat side by side on the edge of the bed. Seoyeon's hands were trembling.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_6.text: "...I always had to be perfect. Because I'm the student council president. But with you... I just want to be me."

day5_bed_seoyeon_7.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_7.text: *Seoyeon rested her head on my shoulder. My heart felt like it would burst.*

day5_bed_yuna_1.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_1.text: *The sun has set. I was about to leave... but Yuna held my hand.*

day5_bed_yuna_2.name: Yuna
day5_bed_yuna_2.text: "...Not yet. There's a place I want to show you."

day5_bed_yuna_3.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_3.text: *Yuna led me to the top of the library annex, a secret attic that no one knows about.*

day5_bed_yuna_4.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_4.text: *An old sofa, a single blanket, and stars visible through a small window. Yuna's secret space.*

day5_bed_yuna_5.name: Yuna
day5_bed_yuna_5.text: "...Only I know about this place. Well, now you do too."

day5_bed_yuna_6.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_6.text: *Yuna spread out the blanket. Sitting side by side on the narrow sofa, our shoulders touched.*

day5_bed_dain_1.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_1.text: *The sun has set. Dain waved a key around with a grin.*

day5_bed_dain_2.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_2.text: "Hey, I've got the key to the gym storage! Let's look at stars and talk!"

day5_bed_dain_3.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_3.text: *The gym at night, empty. Dain laid out mats and opened the skylight in the ceiling.*

day5_bed_dain_4.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_4.text: *We lay side by side on the mats, looking up at the stars. I could hear Dain breathing close by.*

day5_bed_dain_5.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_5.text: "...Hey, my heart is beating so fast right now. Put your hand here."

day5_bed_dain_6.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_6.text: *Dain placed my hand over her chest. It really was... beating fast.*

day5_bed_dain_7.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_7.text: "...Dummy, why are you looking at me like that? It's embarrassing..."

day5_bed_nurse_1.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_1.text: *The sun has set. The school nurse smiled meaningfully.*

day5_bed_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_2.text: "...There should be no one at school yet. Want to stop by the infirmary?"

day5_bed_nurse_3.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_3.text: *Click. I heard the infirmary door lock.*

day5_bed_nurse_4.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_4.text: *The curtained bed area. Instead of disinfectant, a faint perfume scent lingered.*

day5_bed_nurse_5.name: School Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_5.text: "In here... I'm not 'Teacher.' Just a woman."

day5_bed_nurse_6.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_6.text: *We sat side by side on the edge of the bed. Her hand rested on top of mine.*

day5_bed_nurse_7.name: School Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_7.text: "...Just for today, no student, no teacher. Just... us."

day5_bed_teacher_1.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_1.text: *The sun has set. The teacher took out her car keys and jingled them.*

day5_bed_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_2.text: "...I'll give you a ride. It's late."

day5_bed_teacher_3.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_3.text: *The car stopped... not at my house. It was in front of the teacher's apartment.*

day5_bed_teacher_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_4.text: "...Just one cup of coffee. I'll send you home after. Probably."

day5_bed_teacher_5.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_5.text: *A small but tidy apartment. Ungraded exam papers piled on the desk. We sat side by side on the sofa.*

day5_bed_teacher_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_6.text: "...Hah, I really am unfit to be a teacher. Bringing a student home..."

day5_bed_teacher_7.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_7.text: *The teacher let down her hair and smiled wearily. The coffee... ended up going cold.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_1.name: 나
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_1.text: *서로의 체온이 얽힌 채, 말없이 거리가 사라졌던 밤이 지났다.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_2.name: 나
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_2.text: *눈을 뜨자, 창틈으로 스며드는 아침 햇살 속에서 나를 가만히 바라보고 있는 서연이 보였다.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_4.name: 나
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_4.text: *눈이 마주치자 서연의 뺨이 옅게 달아올랐다. 평소의 완벽한 학생회장이 아닌, 오직 나만의 서연이었다.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_5.name: 나
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_5.text: *맞잡은 두 손 사이로 전해지는 온기 속에서, 우리의 평범한 일상이 비로소 기적이 되는 순간을 마주하고 있었다.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_1.name: 나
day5_true_morning_yuna_1.text: *좁은 다락방 소파 위, 서로의 숨결만이 고요하게 섞여들던 밤이 지났다.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_2.name: 나
day5_true_morning_yuna_2.text: *눈을 뜨려는데, 내 팔을 단단히 끌어안고 있는 작은 온기가 느껴졌다.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_3.name: 유나
day5_true_morning_yuna_3.text: "…어딜 가려고. 오늘은 하루 종일 내 옆에 있어."

day5_true_morning_yuna_4.name: 나
day5_true_morning_yuna_4.text: *잠결에 웅얼거리며 내 품으로 더 파고드는 유나. 그 서늘했던 아이가 내게만 보여주는 무방비한 모습이었다.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_5.name: 나
day5_true_morning_yuna_5.text: *이 고요하고 완벽한 세계에서, 나는 그녀의 온전한 안식처가 되기로 다짐했다.*

day5_true_morning_dain_1.name: 나
day5_true_morning_dain_1.text: *별빛이 쏟아지던 체육관 매트 위, 서로의 심장 소리가 하나처럼 겹쳐지던 밤이 지났다.*

day5_true_morning_dain_2.name: 나
day5_true_morning_dain_2.text: *아침 햇살에 눈을 뜨자, 내 배 위로 턱 하니 다리를 걸치고 자는 다인이가 보였다.*

day5_true_morning_dain_3.name: 다인
day5_true_morning_dain_3.text: "...으음, 좋은 아침. 눈 뜨자마자 네가 보이니까... 기분 되게 이상하다."

day5_true_morning_dain_4.name: 나
day5_true_morning_dain_4.text: *눈을 비비며 해맑게 웃는 다인이. 어젯밤의 부끄러움은 온데간데없이, 평소의 밝은 에너지 그대로였다.*

day5_true_morning_dain_5.name: 나
day5_true_morning_dain_5.text: *이 눈부신 미소를 매일 아침 볼 수 있다면, 내 남은 생은 분명 지루할 틈이 없을 것이다.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_1.name: 나
day5_true_morning_nurse_1.text: *은은한 향수 냄새와 함께, 어른의 여유로움에 완전히 이끌렸던 밤이 지났다.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_2.name: 나
day5_true_morning_nurse_2.text: *눈을 뜨자, 턱을 괸 채 내 얼굴을 가만히 내려다보고 있는 선생님과 시선이 마주쳤다.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_3.name: 보건선생님
day5_true_morning_nurse_3.text: "잘 잤어? 우리 학생, 자는 모습도 꽤 귀엽네."

day5_true_morning_nurse_4.name: 나
day5_true_morning_nurse_4.text: *내 뺨을 부드럽게 쓸어내리는 손길. 장난기 어린 미소 뒤에 숨겨진 깊은 애정이 느껴졌다.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_5.name: 나
day5_true_morning_nurse_5.text: *더 이상 선생님과 학생이 아닌, 온전한 두 사람으로서 맞이하는 첫 아침이었다.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_1.name: 나
day5_true_morning_teacher_1.text: *어설프고 서툴렀지만, 그래서 더 진심이 닿았던 밤이 지났다.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_2.name: 나
day5_true_morning_teacher_2.text: *부스럭거리는 소리에 눈을 뜨니, 선생님이 까치발을 들고 몰래 침대에서 빠져나가려 하고 있었다.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_4.name: 나
day5_true_morning_teacher_4.text: *얼굴이 새빨개진 채 어쩔 줄 몰라 하는 선생님의 손을 잡아당겨 다시 품에 안았다.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_5.name: 나
day5_true_morning_teacher_5.text: ("5분만… 이러고 있자." 엄격한 선생님의 가면이 벗겨진, 이 사랑스러운 사람을 평생 지켜주고 싶어졌다.)

day5_good_start.name: Me
day5_good_start.text: *Standing side by side under the sunset. There were complications along the way... but in the end, I'm here with this person.*

day5_good_talk_1.name: Me
day5_good_talk_1.text: "...I'll be honest. At first, my heart wavered. There were so many wonderful people around."

day5_good_talk_2.name: Me
day5_good_talk_2.text: "But in the end... the only one my heart points to is you."

day5_good_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_good_seoyeon.text: "...I knew. That you were being nice to other girls too. But it's okay. You're by my side in the end."

day5_good_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_good_yuna.text: "...I know you wavered. But you came to me in the end. ...That's enough."

day5_good_dain.name: Dain
day5_good_dain.text: "Pfft, I knew from the start! That you'd come to me in the end!! Hehe!"

day5_good_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_good_nurse.text: "I knew you were popular with the students. Hehe... But right now, just look at me."

day5_good_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_good_teacher.text: "...Player. But since you came to me, that's enough. From now on, eyes on me only. Got it?"

day5_good_final.name: Me
day5_good_final.text: *We held hands side by side, watching the sunset. It wasn't perfect... but this is our beginning.*

day5_mayhem_start.name: Me
day5_mayhem_start.text: *I came up to the rooftop... Wait, huh?*

day5_mayhem_3.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_3.text: "Oh, {name}! I was just about to come up to the rooftop too!"

day5_mayhem_5.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_5.text: "Hey!! I'm here too!! Wait, why is everyone here?!"

day5_mayhem_teacher_watch.name: Me
day5_mayhem_teacher_watch.text: *In the distance, the homeroom teacher is watching us. Her expression looks complicated.*

day5_mayhem_nurse_watch.name: Me
day5_mayhem_nurse_watch.text: *The school nurse is also watching the situation through a window.*

day5_mayhem_6.name: Me
day5_mayhem_6.text: *I have a feeling... this is going to be absolute chaos...*

day5_mayhem_7.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_7.text: "By the way {name}, you remember our plans for this weekend, right?"

day5_mayhem_8.name: Yuna
day5_mayhem_8.text: "...What? You made plans with me too."

day5_mayhem_9.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_9.text: "Huh?! Hey! You told me you were free too!!"

day5_mayhem_10.name: Me
day5_mayhem_10.text: *Everyone's eyes turn toward me simultaneously. ...I'm done for.*

day5_mayhem_honest.name: Me
day5_mayhem_honest.text: "A-actually... you're all such wonderful people that I couldn't choose..."

day5_mayhem_run.name: Me
day5_mayhem_run.text: *I sprint toward the rooftop door without looking back!!*

day5_mayhem_run_3.name: Yuna
day5_mayhem_run_3.text: "...Running makes it even worse, you know."

day5_mayhem_run_4.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_run_4.text: "Hey wait!! I won first place in the dash!! You can't escape!!"

day5_mayhem_run_5.name: Me
day5_mayhem_run_5.text: *Everyone chases me down the stairs. Why is everyone so fast?!*

day5_mayhem_confess.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess.text: "...I'm not joking. I sincerely like every single one of you here."

day5_mayhem_confess_2.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_2.text: "It's not that I can't choose— I don't want to choose. If I pick one, I lose the others."

day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon.text: "...Hah. You've really got nerve. You know you'd normally get slapped for saying that, right?"

day5_mayhem_confess_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_mayhem_confess_yuna.text: "...The worst. But... I'll admit you're honest."

day5_mayhem_confess_dain.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_confess_dain.text: "Hey!! That doesn't even make sense!! ...But why don't I hate it?!"

day5_mayhem_confess_silence.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_silence.text: *They all exchange glances. A strange silence hangs in the air.*

day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon_2.text: "...I have one condition. You have to treat me the best."

day5_mayhem_confess_react.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_react.text: *...They all glare at me at once. Their eyes are terrifying.*

day5_mayhem_confess_final.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_final.text: *...This might be the beginning of hell. But in this moment— I'm the happiest man in the world.*

day5_mayhem_final.name: Me
day5_mayhem_final.text: *The sunset fades. Is this how a peaceful Sunday afternoon ends...?*

day5_mayhem_final_2.name: Me
day5_mayhem_final_2.text: *...But why don't I feel so bad? This chaotic everyday life... is kind of its own happiness.*

day5_friend_start.name: Me
day5_friend_start.text: *The sunset paints the rooftop. I look at the face of the person beside me.*

day5_friend_choice.name: Me
day5_friend_choice.text: *This is my last chance to tell them how I feel... What should I do?*

day5_friend_confess.name: Me
day5_friend_confess.text: "The truth is... I like you. I've been trying to say it since yesterday, and I finally found the courage."

day5_late_accept_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_late_accept_seoyeon.text: "...Dummy. I've been waiting this whole time. I... like you too."

day5_late_accept_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_late_accept_yuna.text: "...You're late. Really late. ...But it's okay. I feel the same way."

day5_late_accept_dain.name: Dain
day5_late_accept_dain.text: "...!! Finally!! Do you know how long I've been waiting since yesterday?! I like you too, dummy!!"

day5_late_accept_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_late_accept_nurse.text: "...You're finally saying it? Me too... I've felt the same way. For a long time."

day5_late_accept_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_late_accept_teacher.text: "...Geez, seriously. Why didn't you say so yesterday. I was up all night thinking about it. ...I like you too, dummy."

day5_late_accept_transition1.name: Me
day5_late_accept_transition1.text: *After staring at each other for a while, we burst into laughter.*

day5_late_accept_transition2.name: Me
day5_late_accept_transition2.text: *Something so simple... why did it take so long?*

day5_friend_stay.name: Me
day5_friend_stay.text: "...I'm really glad I met someone like you at this school."

day5_friend_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_friend_seoyeon.text: "...Yeah, me too! Let's stay good friends. ...Friends."

day5_friend_dain.name: Dain
day5_friend_dain.text: "...Yeah! You're the best friend ever! ...The best... friend."

day5_friend_nurse.name: School Nurse
day5_friend_nurse.text: "...Right. You're a good student. ...A good student."

day5_friend_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_friend_teacher.text: "...Yeah, well. Teacher and student, so of course it's natural. ...Of course."

day5_friend_bitter.name: Me
day5_friend_bitter.text: *...Somehow, their smile looked a little sad. A corner of my heart ached too.*

day5_friend_final.name: Me
day5_friend_final.text: *Was this the right choice? ...I don't know. But this too is an ending.*

day5_alone_start.name: Me
day5_alone_start.text: *I watch the sunset alone on the rooftop. Memories of my time at this school flash by.*

day5_alone_2.name: Me
day5_alone_2.text: *Seoyeon, Yuna, Dain, the teachers... There were so many wonderful people.*

day5_alone_3.name: Me
day5_alone_3.text: *Should I have told one of them how I felt? ...Probably.*

day5_alone_4.name: Me
day5_alone_4.text: *But I don't regret it. The time I spent here is precious in itself.*

day5_alone_5.name: Me
day5_alone_5.text: *I'm alone, but I'm not lonely. I've definitely changed from who I was before I transferred.*

day5_alone_6.name: Me
day5_alone_6.text: *Tomorrow is a fresh start. This time... I'll be a little braver.*
